description: The effective nginx settings: each value, the fields an environment variable sets, and when a change takes effect

worker_processes.description: Worker processes: auto or a number from 1 to cpu_count (env NGINX_WORKER_PROCESSES)

worker_shutdown_timeout.description: How long an old worker may finish its connections after a reload: 0 or an nginx time such as 1h or 30s (env NGINX_WORKER_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT)

cpu_affinity.description: Pin the workers to CPUs: off, auto (the CPUs the container may use) or a CPU list such as 16-19 or 16,18,20, cut to the CPUs the container may use when nginx starts or reloads (env NGINX_CPU_AFFINITY)

resolver_addresses.description: Addresses of the DNS servers nginx asks for upstream names: IPv4 addresses or IPv6 addresses in brackets, each with an optional :port, at most 8; empty: the container's own resolvers from /etc/resolv.conf (env NGINX_RESOLVER, space separated)

resolver_hosts.description: Let nginx resolve names from /etc/hosts before asking the DNS servers (env NGINX_RESOLVER_HOSTS)

resolver_ipv6.description: Let nginx resolve names to IPv6 addresses (AAAA records) (env NGINX_RESOLVER_IPV6)

resolver_valid.description: How long nginx keeps an answer, overriding the TTL of the record: an nginx time in seconds or longer such as 30s or 5m, not 0 and not ms; empty: the TTL of each answer (env NGINX_RESOLVER_VALID)

log_not_found.description: Log requests for missing files in the error log (env NGINX_LOG_NOT_FOUND)

tls12.description: Allow TLS 1.2 besides TLS 1.3 (env NGINX_DISABLE_TLS12, inverted); off while force_mlkem is on

force_mlkem.description: Only offer the post-quantum key exchange X25519MLKEM768, which turns TLS 1.2 and the NIST P curves off (env NGINX_FORCE_X25519MLKEM768)

secp_curves.description: Trust the NIST P (secp) curves (env NGINX_TRUST_SECPR1); off while force_mlkem is on

rsa_pkcs1.description: Allow RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signatures (env NGINX_TRUST_RSA_PKCS1)

module_ldap.description: Load the LDAP auth module (env NGINX_LOAD_LDAP_MODULE)

module_vts.description: Load the virtual host traffic status module (env NGINX_LOAD_VHOST_TRAFFIC_STATUS_MODULE)

locked.description: Fields that cannot be changed because an environment variable sets them, or forces them (see locked_by and locked_reason). A save ignores them (read only)

locked_by.description: For each locked field, the environment variable that sets it. A field locked by its own variable names that variable; a field another setting forces names the variable of that setting (read only)

worker_processes.description: Name of the variable that locks the worker processes: NGINX_WORKER_PROCESSES

worker_connections.description: Name of the variable that locks the worker connections: NGINX_WORKER_CONNECTIONS

worker_shutdown_timeout.description: Name of the variable that locks the worker shutdown timeout: NGINX_WORKER_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT

cpu_affinity.description: Name of the variable that locks the cpu affinity: NGINX_CPU_AFFINITY

resolver_addresses.description: Name of the variable that locks the resolver addresses: NGINX_RESOLVER

resolver_hosts.description: Name of the variable that locks the resolver hosts: NGINX_RESOLVER_HOSTS

resolver_ipv6.description: Name of the variable that locks the resolver ipv6: NGINX_RESOLVER_IPV6

resolver_valid.description: Name of the variable that locks the resolver valid: NGINX_RESOLVER_VALID

log_not_found.description: Name of the variable that locks the log not found: NGINX_LOG_NOT_FOUND

tls12.description: Name of the variable that locks the tls12: NGINX_DISABLE_TLS12, or NGINX_FORCE_X25519MLKEM768 when it forces the field

force_mlkem.description: Name of the variable that locks the force mlkem: NGINX_FORCE_X25519MLKEM768

secp_curves.description: Name of the variable that locks the secp curves: NGINX_TRUST_SECPR1, or NGINX_FORCE_X25519MLKEM768 when it forces the field

rsa_pkcs1.description: Name of the variable that locks the rsa pkcs1: NGINX_TRUST_RSA_PKCS1

module_njs.description: Name of the variable that locks the module njs: NGINX_LOAD_NJS_MODULE

module_ldap.description: Name of the variable that locks the module ldap: NGINX_LOAD_LDAP_MODULE

module_ntlm.description: Name of the variable that locks the module ntlm: NGINX_LOAD_NTLM_MODULE

module_vts.description: Name of the variable that locks the module vts: NGINX_LOAD_VHOST_TRAFFIC_STATUS_MODULE

locked_reason.description: Fields locked by the post-quantum only setting (an indirect lock), with the reason: force-mlkem (turned on by NGINX_FORCE_X25519MLKEM768), force-mlkem-setting (turned on by the setting: not an env lock). Fields locked by their own variable are not listed.

tls12.description: Why the tls12 is locked by another setting's variable: force-mlkem or force-mlkem-setting (post-quantum only is on)

secp_curves.description: Why the secp curves is locked by another setting's variable: force-mlkem or force-mlkem-setting (post-quantum only is on)

applies.description: When a change of each field takes effect

worker_processes.description: When a change of the worker processes takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

worker_connections.description: When a change of the worker connections takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

worker_shutdown_timeout.description: When a change of the worker shutdown timeout takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

cpu_affinity.description: When a change of the cpu affinity takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

resolver_addresses.description: When a change of the resolver addresses takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

resolver_hosts.description: When a change of the resolver hosts takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

resolver_ipv6.description: When a change of the resolver ipv6 takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

resolver_valid.description: When a change of the resolver valid takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

log_not_found.description: When a change of the log not found takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

tls12.description: When a change of the tls12 takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

force_mlkem.description: When a change of the force mlkem takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

secp_curves.description: When a change of the secp curves takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

rsa_pkcs1.description: When a change of the rsa pkcs1 takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

module_njs.description: When a change of the module njs takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

module_ldap.description: When a change of the module ldap takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

module_ntlm.description: When a change of the module ntlm takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

module_vts.description: When a change of the module vts takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

restart_pending.description: Always empty: every nginx setting applies with a reload

cpu_count.description: CPU threads of the container, the maximum of worker_processes (read only)

cpus_allowed.description: The CPUs the container may use (Cpus_allowed_list of the backend process), null when it cannot be read (read only)
